people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: He who testifies these things says, “Yes, I come quickly.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus.
translations.bsb: He who testifies to these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen. Come, Lord Jesus!
translations.kjv: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.
translations.asv: He who testifieth these things saith, Yea: I come quickly. Amen: come, Lord Jesus.
